messages:
Maya (Design): quick thread — following up from the studio review: pushed a small variant of the vectors preview with denser rows to fit 8 items per viewport instead of 5. can folks scan for readability + keyboard nav issues?

Ben (Frontend): saw the diff, looks tighter. two quick things: 1) row height feels cramped when metadata wraps, 2) the focus ring disappears on the export button after you hit tab twice. repro: tab to row -> Enter to open preview -> Shift+Tab back -> export loses focus outline.

Sarah (Product): goal is to keep default preview compact but expose a zoom/expanded view. also want copy changes: 'Download vectors' -> 'Export vectors (CSV)' and a short helper text: 'Includes IDs, embeddings, and metadata — for offline reranking'.

Jae (Eng-ML): small flag: when users export large batches we stream the CSV and include a `batch_id` column. ensure header ordering stable: `id, batch_id, vector, metadata`.

Maya (Design): thanks. proposal: default compact rows with a chevron to expand, and a top-level toggle "Dense rows" in the preview drawer. for keyboard: make each row a single tabbable item (enter to expand) and move export to toolbar so it isn't in the row tab order. thoughts?

Ben (Frontend): agree with single tabbable row. moving export to toolbar will help a11y. implementation note: need to keep action buttons reachable from screen reader. we can add `role="toolbar" aria-label="Vector actions"` and keep export inside it.

Sarah (Product): microcopy for relevance table: the current header 'Score' is ambiguous. suggest 'Relevance (0–1)' with a tooltip: 'Higher means more relevant to the query'. also default sort should be by relevance desc, with a small badge showing 'sorted'.

Maya (Design): love that. also flag on colors: we use teal-600 for the score badge which fails contrast at small sizes — either bold text or a darker color. pinging @a11y-bot for contrast check.

A11y-bot: automated check — teal-600 (#0ea5a3) on white has contrast ratio 3.8:1 at 12px normal weight. Recommended: use teal-700 (#0f766e) or increase weight to 600.

Ben (Frontend): will switch to teal-700 for badges; also adding `aria-sort="descending"` on the relevance column header.

Jae (Eng-ML): about reranking UI: users asked for an explanation column (why this item is high). we could show a short excerpt of matching tokens and a tiny confidence bar. keep it optional to avoid clutter.

Maya (Design): mockup idea: small info icon that opens an inline overlay with text like 'Rationale: matched terms in title & description' and a tiny sparklines bar. need to ensure overlay is dismissible with ESC and trap focus.

Ben (Frontend): overlay should use `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` + focus trap. implementation detail: reuse existing dialog component.

Sarah (Product): export format discussion: CSV vs JSONL. CSV easier for non-devs, JSONL better for ML pipelines. propose: export modal with two radio options and a short explanation under each. default to CSV but keep a copy link for advanced users.

Maya (Design): UI copy for modal: Header 'Export vectors', body: 'Choose a format and columns to include.', columns list with checkboxes, primary CTA 'Start export', secondary 'Copy export command'. include example header preview:```\nid,batch_id,vector,metadata\n```

Ben (Frontend): quick note: large vectors in CSV get heavy quoting. maybe compress vector column as base64 for CSV? or prefer JSONL for raw vectors. we should warn users for files > 50MB.

Jae (Eng-ML): yeah add helper line: 'Tip: for large exports choose JSONL or request direct S3 upload.' also include `content-length` estimate based on selected rows.

Maya (Design): accessibility nit: when the export finishes and we offer a download link in the toast, ensure the toast is persistent for screen readers and includes a link with visible text 'Download exported vectors'. avoid generic 'click here'.

Ben (Frontend): +1. also for keyboard users, make toast focusable and put focus on it when download is ready, with a close button.

Sarah (Product): small copy suggestion for relevance table empty state: 'No results — try relaxing filters or upload more examples to improve reranking.' keep it action-oriented with a button 'Upload sample batch'.

Maya (Design): final checklist before I update the prototype: 1) dense rows toggle + expanded view, 2) move export to toolbar + aria labels, 3) relevance header copy + tooltip + aria-sort, 4) contrast change for badges, 5) rationale overlay accessible, 6) export modal CSV/JSONL options + size warning, 7) focusable toast for downloads. anyone object?

Ben (Frontend): no objections. will spike on toolbar + focus behavior tomorrow.

Jae (Eng-ML): fine by me. I'll add the `batch_id` to exports and a size estimator API.

Sarah (Product): good list. please add short acceptance criteria in the ticket: include a demo with keyboard-only walkthrough and a11y checklist pass.

Maya (Design): will update prototype & attach to the ticket. tagging @design-bot to create the design task. :sparkles:

Design-bot: created task D-4822 "Vectors preview: compact rows, export toolbar, a11y fixes" and linked the prototype: https://figma.com/file/xyz 

Maya (Design): thanks everyone. i'll drop updated frames in the ticket by EOD and link QA steps. :white_check_mark:
